highlights: Powerology Paganspo AI Camera Smart Glasses - Gray
The Powerology Paganspo AI Camera Smart Glasses blend advanced technology with elegant design to deliver a smooth and captivating experience.

Featuring a powerful 8MP Sony IMX219 camera, these smart glasses support 2K photo and video recording, AI voice assistance, and real-time translation—transforming how you interact with the world around you.
Whether you’re capturing moments, listening to music, or taking calls, these glasses redefine hands-free convenience.
With dual-mic noise reduction technology and open-ear stereo speakers, enjoy crystal-clear audio while staying aware of your surroundings.
Equipped with 4GB internal storage, 64MB system RAM, and a 410mAh battery, these glasses deliver up to 8 hours of talk time and 10 hours of music playback.
Supporting both Wi-Fi 4 (802.11n) for fast media transfer and Bluetooth 5.2 for seamless pairing, they bring you high performance in a sleek, wearable form.
Designed with IP54 water resistance and a Type-C charging interface, the Powerology Paganspo AI Camera Smart Glasses combine practicality, comfort, and futuristic fashion for modern lifestyles.
AI Voice Assistant: Manage tasks, calls, and media hands-free.
Real-Time Translation: Instantly translate speech or text for global communication.
Dual-Mic Noise Reduction: Delivers clear audio even in noisy environments.
